01-promise.text: On July sixth, Lisa Chen stood at the counter and told me she'd be back for the Solaris.

02-job.text: That's the whole job. A hundred small promises you have to keep.

03-spreadsheet.text: A spreadsheet can hold a name. It can't hold a promise.

05-sheet.text: Monday, the promo sheet lands. Ten models, one page, no context.

06-reads.text: Iris reads it against the catalog, and against everyone who ever said they wanted one.

07-price.text: Solaris. Forty-one fifty, now thirty-seven thirty-five. Seven clients are waiting on it.

08-promise-july.text: One of them made me a promise in July.

09-due.text: The follow-up came due today. I didn't have to remember that.

10-dossier.text: Everything's on one page. What she wanted, what we said, and that she's email only, so I don't text her.

13-hot.text: Warm becomes hot. Because the work happened, not because I typed it.

14-floor.text: Now do that twenty-two more times. Then do it for the whole floor.

15-managers.text: Managers see who's calling, who's converting, where the book is going cold.
